I disagree with the Router's implicit assumption that pseudo-text satisfies the 'bold title typography' checkpoint fully; it should be considered a partial failure or artifact-driven degradation.

The severity of 2.5 is appropriate; it's noticeable and breaks immersion but doesn't destroy the entire image structure. The Router missed explicitly flagging the 'melting' of the bottom title into the character's feet as a distinct 'fusion' artifact, grouping it under texture anomaly. I will elevate this to a 'fusion' artifact due to the semantic error of text merging with anatomy.
